product_version: Nginx 1.29.4/1.29.6/1.29.7; другие продукты — по текущей документации на 2026-11-09
version_sensitive_claims: Nginx proxy_http_version defaults to 1.1 since 1.29.7; HTTP/2 upstream is available since 1.29.4.
Nginx upstream idle keepalive defaults to 32 per worker since 1.29.7; sticky cookie became available in OSS since 1.29.6.
Nginx limit_req rejects with 503 by default; limit_req_status can change the code.
HTTP/3, WebSocket over HTTP/2, tracing, health checks and cache features vary by product, version and configuration.
HAProxy has an in-memory HTTP cache; Envoy has an HTTP cache filter with pluggable storage, so cache capabilities differ by version and configuration.
staleness_risks: Nginx examples require checking the deployed version and enabled modules.
Performance, timeout and cache values require measurement against the target workload.
